summary: Tab-based comments layout on /feud/[id].tsx verified end-to-end at 390x844 web viewport. 36/36 UI assertions pass (one earlier false-fail resolved: post-reply auto-expand is correct; my test had collapsed it again). Setup: signup + PATCH /api/auth/me/profile onboarding, token injected into localStorage under key 'faide_token' (AsyncStorage web backend). Feud with pre-populated comments (feud_9695e67bcd18, 2A+2B) confirms: (a) old testIDs comments-col-a and comments-col-b are GONE from DOM; (b) comments-tabs container + comments-tab-a + comments-tab-b Pressables render; (c) default active side is A when the user has NOT voted (comments-list-a visible, comments-list-b absent); (d) tapping tab-b makes comments-list-b appear and removes comments-list-a from the DOM; tapping tab-a restores it; (e) inactive tab has computed opacity 0.42 vs active 1.0 (verified via getComputedStyle); (f) each CommentItem card shows nickname (@user), relative timestamp ('ora' / 'Nm fa' / 'Nh fa' / 'Ng fa'), full comment text at font.sizes.base with NO truncation (matched byte-for-byte against backend content), red/yellow side accent bar via sideColor(c.side); (g) comment-user-<user_id> Pressable navigates to /user/<user_id>; (h) replies-toggle-<comment_id> Pressable present; (i) after voting side A the tab defaults to A (matches my_vote), 'rispondi' button appears, tapping it reveals reply-input-<id>, submitting posts the reply (verified via /api/comments/<id>/replies GET) and the reply auto-expands inline under the parent with its own accent bar; (j) empty state on feud_d0312abf93bc (0 comments) shows commentsEmpty icon + 'Ancora nessun commento per <party>.' text on both sides; (k) regression: LA FAIDA kicker + summary, FONTI/sources-box, feud-media-section (VIDEO block, Republic World iframe), and voting split UI (vote-a-button, vote-b-button) all render unchanged. No backend regressions.

ui_bugs.issue: After successfully posting a reply, the parent comment's local reply_count (label 'N risposte') is not incremented — only the expanded[] map is refreshed. Label switches to 'Nascondi risposte' immediately (fine) but if the user collapses again the count reverts to the pre-post value until the feud is re-loaded. Reference: /app/frontend/app/feud/[id].tsx submitReply lines 93-101.

action_items: Optional low-priority polish: in submitReply, after posting, either (a) increment the local sideA/sideB comment.reply_count, or (b) re-fetch api.comments(feud_id) to keep the toggle label ('N risposte' vs 'Nascondi risposte') consistent across collapse/expand cycles without a full page reload.
critical_code_review_comments: feud/[id].tsx is 513 lines — approaching the 700-line split threshold. The CommentItem component and cs StyleSheet could be extracted to /src/components/CommentItem.tsx to keep the screen focused.
formatRelative() is defined inline; consider moving to /src/utils/time.ts for reuse if other screens need the same 'ora / Nm fa / Nh fa / Ng fa' formatting.

loadAll auto-sets activeSide from feud.my_vote on every re-load — if the user manually taps the opposite tab and then triggers loadAll (e.g. after posting a comment), their manual choice will be overwritten. Consider guarding with a ref or setting only on first mount.
The 'sideBar' width of 6px + card border of 2px is tight — visually clean at 390 width but on narrow devices <340 the accent bar may look thin against the card body. Not a blocker.

commentsTabIndicator uses colors.onBrandPrimary for both tabs' indicator but is conditionally re-styled to onBrandSecondary for tab B — check contrast when the yellow tab is active on light backgrounds.
